contract.identity: animals[].id is stable; mediaId is optional presentation artwork and never identity
contract.translation: names is locale keyed; geography.animals.<id> is the translation key if a locale is absent here
contract.location: lat/lon is an authored or real-observation representative marker; it is not generated scatter
contract.importance: 1 is most important / visible furthest out; 10 is detail-only
contract.wildlife: Only wild, naturalised, migrant or marine wildlife belongs here. Domestic display animals are excluded.
